articles.title_en: Green Innovation and Economic Growth in a North–South Model
articles.title_cn: 南北模型中的绿色创新与经济增长
articles.abstract_en: If one region of the world switches its research effort from dirty to clean technologies, will other regions follow? To investigate this question, this paper builds a North–South model that combines insights from directed technological change and quality-ladder endogenous growth models with business-stealing innovations. While North represents the region with climate ambitions, both regions have researchers choosing between clean and dirty applications, and the resulting technologies are traded. Three main results emerge: (1) In the long run, if the North’s research and development (R&D) sector is sufficiently large, researchers in South will follow the switch from dirty to clean R&D made by researchers in North, motivated by the growing value of clean markets. (2) If the two regions direct research effort toward different sectors and the outputs of the two sectors are gross substitutes, then the long-run growth rates in both regions will be lower than if the global research effort were invested in one sector. (3) If the North’s government induces its researchers to switch to clean R&D through clean technology subsidies, the welfare-maximising choice for South is to ensure that all of its researchers switch too, unless the social discount rate is high. The last result is true even if the South’s R&D sector is large.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果世界上的一个地区将其研究努力从肮脏技术转向清洁技术，其他地区会效仿吗？为了研究这个问题，本文构建了一个南北模型，该模型结合了定向技术变革和质量阶梯内生增长模型与商业窃取创新的见解。北方代表具有气候雄心的地区，而两个地区的研究人员都在清洁和肮脏应用之间进行选择，由此产生的技术被交易。主要结果有三个：（1）从长期来看，如果北方的研发部门足够大，南方的研究人员将跟随北方研究人员从肮脏研发转向清洁研发，这是由清洁市场价值增长所驱动的。（2）如果两个地区将研究努力导向不同部门，并且两个部门的产出是总替代品，那么两个地区的长期增长率将低于全球研究努力投资于一个部门的情况。（3）如果北方政府通过清洁技术补贴引导其研究人员转向清洁研发，那么南方福利最大化的选择是确保其所有研究人员也转向，除非社会贴现率很高。即使南方的研发部门很大，最后一个结果也成立。

articles.title_en: Drought Exposure and Accuracy: Motivated Reasoning in Climate Change Beliefs
Eliciting Non-hypothetical Willingness-to-pay for Novel Products: An Application to Cultured Meat
Anatomy of Green Specialisation: Evidence from EU Production Data, 1995–2015
articles.title_cn: 绿色专业化的解剖：来自欧盟生产数据的证据，1995-2015
articles.abstract_en: We study green specialisation across EU countries and detailed 4-digit industrial sectors over the period of 1995–2015 by harmonizing product-level data (PRODCOM). We propose a new list of green goods that refines lists proposed by international organizations by excluding goods with double usage. Our analysis reveals important structural characteristics of green specialisation in the manufacturing sector. First, green production is highly concentrated, with 13 out of 119 4-digit industries, which are high-tech and account for nearly 95% of the total. Second, green and polluting productions do not occur in the same sectors, and countries specialise in either green or brown sectors. Third, our econometric analysis identifies three key features as relevant for green specialisation: (i) first-mover advantage and high persistence of green specialisation, (ii) complementarity with non-green capabilities and (iii) the degree of diversification of green capabilities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过统一产品级数据（PRODCOM），研究了1995-2015年期间欧盟各国及详细的4位数工业部门的绿色专业化。我们提出了一个新的绿色商品清单，该清单通过排除双重用途的商品，对国际组织提出的清单进行了细化。我们的分析揭示了制造业中绿色专业化的重要结构特征。首先，绿色生产高度集中，在119个4位数工业中，有13个是高科技行业，占总量的近95%。其次，绿色生产和污染生产不会出现在同一部门，各国要么专精于绿色部门，要么专精于棕色部门。第三，我们的计量经济学分析确定了与绿色专业化相关的三个关键特征：（i）先发优势和绿色专业化的高持续性，（ii）与非绿色能力的互补性，以及（iii）绿色能力的多样化程度。

articles.title_en: The Impacts of Removing Fossil Fuel Subsidies and Increasing Carbon Taxation in Ireland
articles.title_cn: 爱尔兰取消化石燃料补贴与提高碳税的影响
articles.abstract_en: Though the magnitude of fossil fuel subsidies eclipses carbon pricing revenues, policies and economic literature focus on carbon taxation. This paper aims to show that removing fossil fuel subsidies can reduce emissions as much as carbon taxation without making producers and consumers worse off. Using a dynamic intertemporal CGE model of Ireland, we compare removing eight Irish fossil fuel subsidies and increasing the carbon tax to €100 per tonne by 2030. We find that both policies result in similar emission reductions. Carbon taxation results in lower negative GDP and investment impacts, whereas subsidy removal results in lower negative employment impacts, higher revenues, an improved trade balance and lower debt. The impacts across sectors and households are distributed more evenly under a carbon tax, where subsidy removal results in extreme impacts for specific sectors and households. Excluding households’ subsidies from removal can alleviate these household distributional impacts at no cost to emission reduction. With revenue recycling reducing tax rates, a double-dividend is found at the expense of worsened income distribution. The economic benefit of revenue recycling is greater when removing subsidies than with carbon taxation and results confirm the importance of fossil fuel subsidies in climate policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管化石燃料补贴的规模超过了碳定价收入，但政策和经济文献侧重于碳税。本文旨在表明，取消化石燃料补贴可以在不使生产者和消费者状况恶化的情况下，实现与碳税同等的减排效果。利用爱尔兰的动态跨期CGE模型，我们比较了取消八项爱尔兰化石燃料补贴与到2030年将碳税提高至每吨€100的影响。我们发现，两种政策都能带来相似的减排效果。碳税导致的GDP和投资负面影响较小，而取消补贴则导致就业负面影响较小、收入更高、贸易平衡改善和债务降低。在碳税下，各部门和家庭之间的影响分布更为均匀，而取消补贴则对特定部门和家庭产生极端影响。将家庭补贴排除在取消范围之外，可以在不牺牲减排效果的情况下缓解这些家庭分配影响。通过收入循环降低税率，发现了双重红利，但以收入分配恶化为代价。取消补贴时收入循环的经济效益大于碳税，结果证实了化石燃料补贴在气候政策中的重要性。

articles.title_en: Drivers of Bilateral Climate Finance Aid: The Roles of Paris Agreement Commitments, Public Governance, and Multilateral Institutions
articles.title_cn: 双边气候融资援助的驱动因素：《巴黎协定》承诺、公共治理和多边机构的作用
articles.abstract_en: Using granular data from the OECD from 2010 to 2018 that differentiate between adaptation and mitigation measures to address climate change, we employed a double-hurdle model to examine whether countries’ Paris Agreement commitments and governance capacity help attract international climate-change-related financial aid. We found that (1) countries received a short-term aid boost in the year when they submitted the nationally determined contribution, and countries that committed only to action targets rather than emission goals were more likely to receive funds; (2) both the quality of the budget and financial management and the quality of public administration significantly enhanced the likelihood of receiving aid, but only the quality of public administration contributed to attracting funding for adaptations; and (3) multilateral institutions played catalytic roles in fostering bilateral international climate-change aid, particularly by increasing the likelihood of funding.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用经合组织2010年至2018年区分气候变化适应和减缓措施的微观数据，我们采用双障碍模型考察了各国的《巴黎协定》承诺和治理能力是否有助于吸引国际气候变化相关财政援助。我们发现：（1）各国在提交国家自主贡献的当年获得了短期援助提振，且仅承诺行动目标而非排放目标的国家更有可能获得资金；（2）预算和财务管理质量以及公共行政质量均显著提高了获得援助的可能性，但只有公共行政质量有助于吸引适应资金；（3）多边机构在促进双边国际气候变化援助方面发挥了催化作用，特别是提高了获得资金的可能性。
